title: Dedemin Büyük Sırrı
author: Merve Edeer
description: When their parents leave for an overnight business trip, a young child is over the moon to spend the night wih his lively ninety-year-old grandpa. After a fun-filled day of experiments, Grandpa wakes the child with an unexpected confession: ever since getting lost in a forest as a boy, he has sometimes been afraid of the dark, and of the monsters that might be hiding in it. Determined to help the grandfather who has always supported him, the child turns fear into laughter through the power of imagination. Together, they draw a terrifying monster, then transform it into a hilarious creature with heart-covered underpants, toilet paper, and a bird perched on its head.
